verdict.rationale: No documentation in the evidence pack describes per-second or usage-based billing for sandbox compute; the only pricing-related evidence is community commentary describing flat, expensive per-vCPU pricing (comm-3, comm-6) and the absence of automatic idle shutdown, meaning engineers must build their own cleanup to avoid being billed for idle sandboxes (comm-7). This contradicts rather than supports the story of paying only for actual per-second compute use.
